root.name: シェニエール・エナジー

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: コーパスクリスティの増設を一括請負で建設(Train 8・9は約29億ドル)
relations.text_en: Builds its Corpus Christi expansions under lump-sum EPC contracts (about $2.9 billion for Trains 8 & 9)

source.label: Cheniere 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Additionally, in June 2025, our Board made a positive FID with respect to the CCL Midscale Trains 8 & 9 Project and issued a full notice to proceed with construction to Bechtel under an EPC contract for a contract price of approximately $2.9 billion, subject to adjustment only by change order.

relations.text: LNG運搬船5隻を固定料金で長期傭船
relations.text_en: Charters five LNG carriers from Flex LNG at fixed rates

source.label: Flex LNG 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: In April 2021, and through a series of actions since, the Company has entered into fixed rate time charter agreements with Cheniere Marketing International LLP, or Cheniere, for five LNG carriers.

companies.name: キャピタル・クリーン・エナジー・キャリアーズ

relations.text: LNG運搬船の傭船先の一社

source.label: Capital Clean Energy Carriers 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: In April 2021, each of the vessel-owning companies of the LNG/C Aristarchos and the LNG/C Asklipios, entered into a time charter agreement with Cheniere until March 15, 2025 (+/- 30 days) and February 5, 2025 (+/- 30 days).

relations.text: サビンパス基地の再ガス化設備1Bcf/日を長期で借りる顧客(固定料金)
relations.text_en: Long-term user of 1 Bcf/d of Sabine Pass regasification capacity, paying fixed fees

source.label: Cheniere 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: SPLNG has a long-term, third party TUA for 1 Bcf/d with TotalEnergies Gas & Power North America, Inc.

companies.name: ポスコ・ホールディングス

relations.text: 2026年11月から15年間、年37万トンのLNGを購入する契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy 370,000 tonnes of LNG a year for 15 years from November 2026

source.label: POSCO Holdings 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: entered into a purchase agreement with Cheniere Marketing, LLC to purchase 370 thousand tons of LNG annually for 15 years commencing in November 2026

companies.name: シェニエール・エナジー・パートナーズ

relations.text: サビンパスを運営する上場子会社(持分48.6%と無限責任社員)
relations.text_en: Listed subsidiary that runs Sabine Pass; Cheniere holds 48.6% and the general partner

source.label: Cheniere 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we owned 100% of the general partner interest, a 48.6% limited partner interest and 100% of the incentive distribution rights of CQP.

relations.text: 子会社CQPの持分をBrookfieldと共に保有し、取締役を指名
relations.text_en: Holds part of CQP alongside Brookfield and appoints directors

source.label: Cheniere 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The remaining 49.4 % non-controlling limited partner interest in CQP is held by affiliates of Blackstone Inc. and Brookfield Asset Management, Inc. as well as the public.

relations.text: 子会社CQPの持分をBlackstoneと共に保有し、取締役を指名
relations.text_en: Holds part of CQP alongside Blackstone and appoints directors

source.label: Cheniere 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The remaining 49.4 % non-controlling limited partner interest in CQP is held by affiliates of Blackstone Inc. and Brookfield Asset Management, Inc. as well as the public.

companies.name: ベンチャー・グローバル

relations.text: Venture Globalが10-Kで、独立系LNG生産者の競合としてシェニエールを挙げる
relations.text_en: Venture Global names Cheniere among independent LNG producers it competes with

source.label: Venture Global 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: independent LNG producers, including Cheniere and Freeport LNG
